WITH grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        m.member_id,
        m.position,
        COUNT(*) as attendance_count
    FROM attendance a
    INNER JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.position
),
with_share AS (
    SELECT 
        member_id,
        position,
        attendance_count,
        CAST(attendance_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(attendance_count) OVER () as share
    FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
    member_id,
    position,
    attendance_count,
    share
FROM with_share
WHERE share >= (
    SELECT MIN(share)
    FROM (
        SELECT share FROM with_share
        ORDER BY share DESC
        LIMIT 10
    )
)
ORDER BY share DESC
